results.name: Motocross of Nations (FIM, non-AMA)
results.summary: Team Belgium (Lucas Coenen, Sacha Coenen, Liam Everts) won with 23 points — its first Nations win since 2013 — ahead of Spain (26, its first-ever podium) and the Netherlands (34). Team USA was 5th (53): Cooper Webb 6-6 (4th in Open), Julien Beaumer 10-17, Levi Kitchen 25-14 after being knocked down in Race 1. results.venue: Thunder Ridge Nature Arena, Ridgedale, MO
results.summary: Triple-points finale. Haiden Deegan won the 450SMX overall (1-2) but Jorge Prado (5-1) clinched the 450SMX title by 7 points. Cole Davies swept the 250SMX (1-1) while Levi Kitchen (2-2) took the 250SMX title.

results.name: Ironman National (Pro Motocross finale, Round 11)
results.summary: Jorge Prado (1-1) won the 450 overall; Hunter Lawrence (8-4, 4th) beat brother Jett by 2 points for the 450 title. Julien Beaumer (2-1) won the 250 overall; Cole Davies (3-13, 7th) clinched the 250 title after Levi Kitchen's Moto 1 DNF.

news.title: Brycen Neal clinches fifth GNCC ATV title at the Yamaha Racing Ironman
news.summary: At the pink-themed Yamaha Racing Ironman GNCC (Round 12 of 13, Crawfordsville, IN), Phoenix Racing Yamaha's Brycen Neal won the Saturday Oct 24 pro ATV race to clinch his fifth XC1 Pro ATV national championship (332 pts). Yamaha swept the top six overall: Neal, Hunter Hart, Wyatt Wilkin, John Glauda Jr., Branden Owens, Steven Harrell. Honda's Layne McCormick won XC2 and leads that title chase 268–261 over Braxton Grosse (Honda). GNCC had not published a pro bike race report for Sunday's race when checked Oct 26.

source.name: GNCC Racing – Yamaha Racing Ironman ATV race report (Oct 25, 2026)

news.title: Kawasaki and Chase Sexton part ways, effective immediately
news.summary: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A. and Chase Sexton announced late Friday, Oct 23, that they had mutually agreed to part ways effective that day, ending a reported three-year deal after one season. Kawasaki's statement highlighted his two 2026 450SX wins (Anaheim and Salt Lake City). Sexton has no announced 2027 team; Supercross.com (updated Oct 24) stresses that any destination is still unconfirmed. Media speculation includes KTM, Star Yamaha, Quad Lock Honda and Suzuki, depending on Ken Roczen's decision. It's the second year running that Kawasaki has split early with a big-name signing, after Jorge Prado.

source.name: Racer X – Kawasaki and Chase Sexton part ways (Oct 23, 2026)

news.title: Racerhead: Malcolm Stewart out of Paris SX; 2027 KX450 lands in early November
news.summary: Racer X's Racerhead #43 reports that Malcolm Stewart, the 2025 Paris SX winner, won't race Paris this year (Nov 21–22) because his new Kawasaki team didn't want him racing in Europe with the new 2027 KX450 coming. Paris SX promoter Eric Peronnard told PulpMX that Kawasaki agreed to support Stewart there next year, and Triumph's Jordon Smith is expected to step in. The same column says the 2027 Kawasaki KX450 reaches dealers in early November (media intro Nov 23), the Ducati Desmo 250 is at dealers now (intro Oct 28), and KTM's 250/450 Factory Editions arrive in December (intro Nov 18). Cooper Webb is training on his new Team Tedder Husqvarna at North Carolina's Aus Ranch with Quad Lock Honda's Cameron McAdoo.

news.title: Michael Mosiman signs with Quad Lock Honda for 2027
news.summary: After leaving Monster Energy Yamaha Star Racing, Mosiman will race Quad Lock Honda's 250 program in 2027 AMA Supercross, Pro Motocross and the SMX Playoffs. He joins Cameron McAdoo, with the team citing increased American Honda backing and Kevin Windham's role in rider development and testing. Mosiman won a 250SX West main event and was third in the 2022 West standings.

source.name: Racer X – Michael Mosiman to Quad Lock Honda (Oct 22, 2026)

news.title: Yamaha Racing Ironman GNCC goes pink this weekend (Oct 23–25)
news.summary: The penultimate round of the AMA National Championship GNCC series runs Oct 23–25 in Crawfordsville, Indiana. Yamaha will donate $50 per Yamaha class win plus $50 per national title earned by Yamaha riders to the Montgomery County Community Foundation's free mammogram program; last year the GNCC community donated $10,000.

source.name: Racer X – Ironman GNCC turns pink (Oct 21, 2026)

news.title: Ken Roczen still undecided on 2027 as reigning 450SX champ
news.summary: Supercross.com's Oct 20–21 coverage lists Ken Roczen among riders with no announced 2027 deal; the reigning 450SX champion has said publicly he is undecided between racing on and retiring. He races the AUSX Open in Geelong (Nov 7) alongside new Suzuki teammate Justin Barcia. Also still unannounced: Malcolm Stewart, Michael Mosiman, Joey Savatgy, Casey Cochran, Jalek Swoll, Garrett Marchbanks and Ducati's second 450 seat.

news.title: By the numbers: Nate Thrasher's six seasons with Star Yamaha
news.summary: Racer X's Mitch Kendra crunched Thrasher's Yamaha career before his 2027 move to Pro Circuit Kawasaki. With his 2026 Cleveland win he became the first rider to win a 250SX race in six straight seasons. His 250SX average finish was 8.9 in each of 2024, 2025 and 2026, and 8.4 over 54 starts, with 7 wins, 14 podiums and 23 top fives. Across 103 Yamaha starts in SX, MX and SMX he had 51 single-digit and 52 double-digit finishes. Openers have been his weak spot (11-12-15-21-8-11), and he never scored an overall 250 Pro Motocross podium in 41 starts.

source.name: Racer X – Wild stats about Nate Thrasher's time with Star Yamaha (Oct 20, 2026)

news.title: Fox Raceway becomes 'Pala Raceway Presented by Fox Racing' again
news.summary: Fox Racing announced a new partnership with the Pala Band of Mission Indians that brings back the name 'Pala Raceway Presented by Fox Racing' for the Southern California track. It had been called Fox Raceway since the partnership began in 2018. Fox stays on as sponsor, including the 2027 Pro Motocross season opener there in May (May 29, 2027). Nick Wey is still among the track operators.

source.name: Racer X – Fox Racing press release: Pala Raceway name reinstated (Oct 19, 2026)

news.title: Nate Thrasher leaves Star Yamaha for Monster Energy/Pro Circuit Kawasaki in 2027
news.summary: Pro Circuit Kawasaki announced its five-rider 250 lineup for the 2027 SMX season on Oct 19: newcomer Nate Thrasher plus returning Levi Kitchen (reigning 250SMX champion), Seth Hammaker, Drew Adams and Nick Romano, whose 2026 fill-in ride becomes a full-time deal. Thrasher spent his first seven pro seasons with Monster Energy Yamaha Star Racing and has seven career 250SX wins, the latest at Cleveland (Round 14) in 2026. He'll ride the KX250F, train in Florida with Kitchen and Romano, and says his goal is a championship and 10 race wins.

source.name: Racer X – Pro Circuit Kawasaki 2027 roster: Thrasher joins (Oct 19, 2026)

news.title: Joey Savatgy and Quad Lock Honda part ways after WSX's collapse
news.summary: Quad Lock Honda confirmed Oct 16 that it and Joey Savatgy are splitting after three seasons. The team said the cancellation of World Supercross removed a core part of its Honda program and its commitments to Savatgy, so it can't go ahead with his 2027 contract as planned; owner Yarrive Konsky said the team will now focus on its American program. Savatgy (8th in 2026 450SX) also won't race AUSX for Honda. MotoOnline reports he's the leading candidate to join R.J. Hampshire at Troy Lee Designs Red Bull Ducati, but nothing is official yet.

source.name: Racer X – Quad Lock Honda thanks Joey Savatgy (Oct 16, 2026)

news.title: Gavin Towers joins Partzilla ROKiT PRMX Racing — another Yamaha signing for 2027
news.summary: Partzilla ROKiT PRMX Racing announced Gavin Towers (formerly Team VRT Yamaha) on social media on Oct 16 with a short “Welcome @15towers” post, the same day it confirmed Evan Ferry. The team switches from Kawasaki to Yamaha machinery for 2027.

source.name: MX Vice – Towers joins Partzilla ROKiT PRMX Racing (Oct 16, 2026)

news.title: Justin Barcia locked in for AUSX Open Geelong on his new Twisted Tea Suzuki
news.summary: AUSX confirmed Oct 16 that Justin “Bam Bam” Barcia will race the Boost Mobile AUSX Open at GMHBA Stadium on Nov 7 aboard his new Twisted Tea Suzuki presented by Progressive Insurance (Pipes Motorsports Group), lining up with teammate and AMA Supercross champion Ken Roczen. The SX1 field also includes Jo Shimoda (Australian 450 debut), Townsville winner Christian Craig, Cedric Soubeyras and Luke Clout. Barcia was first announced for the 2018 AUS-X Open but withdrew after eye surgery.

source.name: AUSX – Barcia locked in for Geelong (Oct 16, 2026)

news.title: Evan Ferry signs with Partzilla ROKiT PRMX Racing — on a Yamaha for 2027
news.summary: The 22-year-old son of Tim Ferry, previously with 5.11 Triumph and Phoenix Racing Honda, joins Julien Perrier’s PRMX team for the 2027 SMX season. After ten years with Kawasaki, PRMX switches to Yamaha in 2027, so Ferry will race a Yamaha.

news.title: Official: Yamaha Motor Europe restructures its MXGP program and ends factory MX2 involvement
news.summary: Confirming last week’s rumor, Yamaha Motor Europe will run the Yamaha Factory Racing MXGP team in-house from its new Motorsport R&D facility in Gerno di Lesmo, Italy, conclude factory MX2 involvement with immediate effect, and restructure its EMX250/EMX125 programs. Management and the full MXGP rider line-up will be announced later; Yamaha thanked Kemea and Hutten Metaal.

source.name: Racer X – Yamaha Motor Europe release (Oct 14, 2026)

news.title: Ryder DiFrancesco and Daxton Bennick officially sign with Red Bull KTM
news.summary: After Rockstar Husqvarna shut down, the 2026 250SMX runner-up (DiFrancesco) and 250SX East 3rd-place finisher (Bennick) join Julien Beaumer and Sacha Coenen in a four-rider KTM 250 SX-F Factory Edition program; ex-Husqvarna manager Nathan Ramsey runs the 250 team. Jorge Prado and Lucas Coenen make up the 450 side.

news.title: 2027 Supercross: tickets on sale to all, Triple Crowns and 250 East/West rounds set
news.summary: SMX League put every 2027 SX and Pro Motocross round on general-public sale and named Triple Crowns at Anaheim 2 (Jan 23), Arlington (Feb 27) and Foxborough (Apr 3). 250 West runs Rds 1–4, 8, 11, 16; East runs Rds 5, 7, 9, 10, 12–14; East/West Showdowns are Glendale (Feb 13), Pittsburgh (Apr 24) and the Salt Lake City finale (May 15). St. Jude races: Glendale and the Ironman MX finale; Military Appreciation: Seattle and Washougal.

news.title: Max Anstie pivots to Australian SX on a 2027 Yamaha with ClubMX
news.summary: With WSX shut down, the ClubMX Yamaha rider (who left Star Racing mid-2026) says he arranged a deal to race the rest of the AUSX championship on the 2027 Yamaha 250 as prep for 2027 AMA Supercross; he stays on a 250 for SX.

news.title: MXA tests the 2027 Yamaha YZ450F against its 2026 shootout winner
news.summary: Motocross Action rode the ’27 next to a stock ’26 at Glen Helen. The main change is inside the fork (15cc more oil, softened valving); MXA found it rode higher in the stroke and felt harsher than the ’26 on day one and published its fork/shock settings.

news.title: Chad Reed eyes a TwoTwo Motorsports comeback, targeting 2028
news.summary: Reed told GateDrop he is working to relaunch his team with a major partner (he confirmed talks are happening around Michael Jordan but not his involvement); facilities and trucks would need to be set by January 2027.

news.title: Jeffrey Herlings wins FastCross in Italy; Cooper Webb finishes 4th
news.summary: One week after MXoN, the FastCross invitational in Arsago Seprio (Oct 10–11) went to Honda’s Jeffrey Herlings (5-1-1). Jan Pancar (KTM) was 2nd overall, Liam Everts (Husqvarna) 3rd, and Team Tedder Husqvarna’s Cooper Webb 4th (3-3-4). Tom Vialle won Race 1 after Herlings and Everts crashed at turn one.

news.title: Red Bull Day in the Dirt Out East concludes at High Point Raceway
news.summary: The Oct 9–11 'MX Woodstock' amateur festival at High Point Raceway (Mount Morris, PA) wrapped Sunday. Program included the Out East Reunion Race, Vintage and 2-Stroke GPs, team races and Vet/Pro-Am classes. No official overall/Ironman results list was published on the sources checked Oct 12. Next Day in the Dirt: Nov 27–29 at Glen Helen Raceway.

source.name: Racer X – Day in the Dirt Out East schedule (Oct 7, 2026) + Fasthouse event page

news.title: Levi and Jagger Townley moving to the U.S. for 2027; Yamaha Star Racing development deals reported
news.summary: Ben Townley confirmed to GateDrop that sons Levi (to 250cc) and Jagger (to 125cc) are leaving Europe for America in 2027, aiming at the SMX Futures pathway. In Racerhead #41, Davey Coombs wrote that Ben Townley told him both have development deals with Yamaha Star Racing and were moving into a Tallahassee, FL home.

source.name: GateDrop – Townleys to America (excl.) + Racer X Racerhead #41 (Oct 9, 2026)

news.title: PulpMX tests the 2027 Yamaha YZ450F: refinement, not reinvention
news.summary: Kris Keefer’s ride impression says the 2027 YZ450F carries over the 2026 engine/frame/hydraulic clutch package with a smaller, lighter rear brake (220 mm rotor, ~180 g saved), softer fork valving and a revised clutch hose. Verdict: worthwhile refinement vs 2026, bigger step if coming from 2025 or older.

news.title: R.J. Hampshire signs with Troy Lee Designs Red Bull Ducati for 2027
news.summary: Hampshire signed a multi-year deal to race the Ducati Desmo 450MX in the premier class. The 2024 250SX West champion finished fifth in AMA Pro Motocross in both 2025 and 2026, with a 2026 podium at Ironman. The Ducati team's best 2026 result was fourth overall at Hangtown.

news.title: World Supercross cancels the rest of its 2026 season
news.summary: SX Global ended the rest of the 2026 FIM World Supercross Championship after only the weather-shortened Calgary round. That makes Calgary winners Cooper Webb (450) and Max Anstie (250) the 2026 WSX champions. The series said it remains in talks with potential investors.

news.title: Partzilla ROKiT PRMX Racing switches from Kawasaki to Yamaha for 2027
news.summary: Owner Julien Perrier’s Canadian-based privateer team moves from Kawasaki to Yamaha for the 2027 SuperMotocross season (Motocross.com reported 450 rider Mitchell Harrison and manager Kraig Riese return). Full roster not yet confirmed.

news.title: Michael Mosiman is leaving Monster Energy Yamaha Star Racing
news.summary: Mosiman announced on YouTube that he's moving on from Star Racing Yamaha after three seasons (four podiums, 22 top-tens in SX and MX). He didn't name his 2027 team or bike but confirmed he'll keep racing.

news.title: Belgium wins the 2026 Motocross of Nations in Ernée
news.summary: Lucas and Sacha Coenen and Liam Everts won Belgium's first Peter Chamberlain Trophy since 2013 with 23 points. Spain (26) took its first-ever Nations podium and the Netherlands (34) was third. Febvre won Race 1; Herlings won Races 2 and 3. MXGP organizers reported a record crowd of over 105,000 for the weekend.

news.title: Team USA finishes fifth at MXoN
news.summary: Cooper Webb went 6-6 in his Husqvarna debut, Julien Beaumer scored 10-17 on a 450, and Levi Kitchen was knocked down by Italy's Alberto Forato in Race 1 before finishing 14th in Race 2. USA ended 5th with 53 points, one behind Latvia.

news.title: Assen, Netherlands to host the 2027 Motocross of Nations
news.summary: Infront Moto Racing announced TT Circuit Assen will host the 2027 MXoN on Oct 8–10, 2027, with a new sand track layout planned. Assen last hosted in 2019.

source.name: Racer X – Assen to host 2027 MXoN (Oct 4, 2026)

news.title: Justin Barcia joins Suzuki and Pipes Motorsports Group for 2027
news.summary: Barcia will race the 2027 SuperMotocross season on the RM-Z450 for the team that won the 2026 Supercross title, on a 2027 deal with a mutual option for 2028. His Suzuki debut is the Jan 9 opener at Anaheim.

source.name: Racer X – Barcia joins Suzuki & Pipes Motorsports (Oct 3, 2026)

news.title: Christian Craig and Brodie Connolly win the AUSX Supercross opener in Townsville
news.summary: Quad Lock Honda's Christian Craig went 1-1 to win SX1 ahead of Cedric Soubeyras (Kawasaki) and Luke Clout (KTM). Honda Racing's Brodie Connolly won SX2 with 1-3 scores; Cameron McAdoo, in his Factory Honda Australia return, was caught in a Final 1 incident and finished fifth overall. Round 2 is Oct 31 at North Harbour Stadium in Auckland, New Zealand, with Ken Roczen and Cole Davies attending. (Australian series, not AMA.)

source.name: Racer X – AUSX Round 1 press release (Oct 5, 2026)

news.title: Cameron McAdoo leaves Pro Circuit Kawasaki for Quad Lock Honda
news.summary: McAdoo joins Quad Lock Honda for the 2027 AMA Supercross 250 class with more support from American Honda. With WSX canceling its second round, he was heading to Factory Honda Australia for the Australian Supercross opener in Townsville.

source.name: Racer X – McAdoo joins Quad Lock Honda (Oct 2, 2026)

news.title: Horizon Award winner Landon Gibson signs with Triumph
news.summary: After the Rockstar Husqvarna factory team shut down, Gibson signed with Triumph Racing America through 2027 to race the SMX Next series and the major amateur nationals on the TF 250-X.

source.name: Racer X – Landon Gibson signs with Triumph (Oct 2, 2026)

news.title: 2027 SMX regular-season schedule released: Anaheim Jan 9, Pala May 29
news.summary: The SMX League published all 17 Supercross and 11 Pro Motocross dates and venues. New SX stops include San Antonio’s Alamodome and Baltimore’s M&T Bank Stadium. Playoff cities come in January; ticket presale registration opens Oct 6.

news.title: Cooper Webb joins Rocky Mountain ATV/MC – Monster Energy – Team Tedder – Husqvarna
news.summary: Three-time 450SX champion Cooper Webb signed a multi-year deal with Team Tedder on Husqvarna for 2027–28, reuniting with the brand. He debuts the FC 450 Factory Edition this weekend for Team USA at MXoN Ernée alongside returning teammate Justin Hill.

source.name: SupercrossLIVE – Cooper Webb joins Team Tedder Husqvarna (Oct 1)

news.title: Aaron Plessinger leaves Red Bull KTM for 5.11 Factory Triumph
news.summary: Plessinger ends a five-year run with KTM and signs a two-year deal with Triumph covering the full SuperMotocross schedule on the TF 450-X. He's introduced at Triumph's Global Dealer Conference in Thailand Oct 6–9, then races the Paris Supercross before preparing for 2027.

source.name: NBC Sports – Plessinger joins Factory Triumph (Oct 1, 2026)

news.title: Honda and Yamaha to stage EV motocross demos at MXoN Ernée
news.summary: Honda’s CR ELECTRIC PROTO (Trey Canard, Justin Brayton) and Yamaha’s YE-01 Racing Concept (Ben Townley, Milko Potisek) will run side-by-side demonstration laps Saturday and Sunday at 12:45 local time.

news.title: AMA releases 2027 SX, MX and SMX numbers: new career numbers for Davies, DiFrancesco and Prado
news.summary: Cole Davies takes #5, Ryder DiFrancesco #10 and Jorge Prado #61. The AMA also confirmed the 2027 Supercross season will have 17 rounds, with the official schedule still to come.

news.title: Monster Energy SMX World Championship crowns first-time champions
news.summary: Jorge Prado became the first Spanish-born SMX World Champion (450SMX) and Levi Kitchen won the 250SMX title. Lachlan Turner won the first WMX Invitational.

news.title: SMX Final recap: Ridgedale
news.summary: Haiden Deegan won the 450SMX overall but Prado clinched the title by seven points; Kitchen finished 24 points clear of Ryder DiFrancesco in the 250SMX standings.

news.title: Dylan Ferrandis announces retirement
news.summary: The Troy Lee Designs Red Bull Ducati rider said the SMX Final in Missouri would be his last race as a professional.

news.title: Jett Lawrence to undergo surgery, miss SMX postseason
news.summary: The reigning three-time SMX World Champion did not defend his title, instead having a follow-up procedure on his previously repaired ankle.

source.name: Honda HRC Progressive – Jett Lawrence to miss SMX Playoffs

models.title: Race team news — Yamaha ends factory MX2 GP effort; Anstie on a 2027 Yamaha in AUSX
models.text: Yamaha Motor Europe confirmed Oct 14 it is bringing its MXGP team in-house at a new R&D facility in Italy and ending factory MX2 involvement immediately (EMX250/EMX125 restructured). ClubMX Yamaha’s Max Anstie races the rest of the 2026 AUSX series on a 2027 Yamaha 250 as prep for 2027 AMA SX (SPEED SPORT, Oct 13).

source.name: Racer X – Yamaha Motor Europe release (Oct 14, 2026)

models.title: Race team news — Townley brothers headed to U.S. / Star Racing development (reported)
models.text: Levi and Jagger Townley are moving from Europe to the U.S. for 2027 (Levi to 250cc, Jagger to 125cc) per Ben Townley to GateDrop. Racer X’s Davey Coombs reported Ben Townley told him both have Yamaha Star Racing development deals and were settling in Tallahassee, FL. Official Star Racing roster confirmation was not published on the pages checked.

models.title: Race team news — PRMX joins Yamaha; Mosiman and Thrasher leave Star Racing
models.text: Partzilla ROKiT PRMX Racing is switching from Kawasaki to Yamaha for 2027 (Mitchell Harrison returns; Evan Ferry signed Oct 15, Gavin Towers Oct 16), while Michael Mosiman announced he's leaving Monster Energy Yamaha Star Racing after three seasons; on Oct 22 he signed with Quad Lock Honda's 250 team for 2027 (Racer X). On Oct 19 Nate Thrasher, with Star Racing since his 2020 pro debut, was confirmed at Monster Energy/Pro Circuit Kawasaki for 2027 (Racer X).

source.name: Racer X – PRMX moves to Yamaha (Oct 7, 2026)

models.title: 2027 WR450F – updated enduro flagship
models.text: Yamaha’s 2027 WR450F page highlights a new light/compact high-revving 450cc engine with trail/enduro ECU settings, KYB suspension, 2.0 gal tank, 18-inch rear wheel and enduro equipment. Destination charge listed at $675; MSRP was not shown on the Yamaha page checked.

models.title: 2027 YZ450F – carryover with a new rear brake
models.text: Mechanically a refinement of the 2026 package: graphics plus an all-new more compact rear brake (220 mm rotor; Yamaha claims ~180 g saved), softer fork valving/higher oil volume and a revised hydraulic clutch hose. PulpMX (Oct 8) called it worthwhile refinement; MXA (Oct 13) found the new fork rode higher and felt harsher than the ’26 on day one and published its settings. $10,299 MSRP Team Yamaha Blue; Monster Energy Edition $10,499.

source.name: MXA – 2027 YZ450F test (Oct 13, 2026) + PulpMX (Oct 8) + Yamaha USA

models.title: 2027 YZ450FX – new engine and updated frame for XC racing
models.text: Yamaha bills the 2027 YZ450FX as its 'ultimate woods racer': a new liquid-cooled DOHC 450cc four-stroke with XC-tuned ECU settings for low-end tractability and top-end power, Power Tuner app support, an updated aluminum bilateral beam frame with FX-specific engine mounts, fully adjustable KYB speed-sensitive coil fork with toolless compression clickers, and a cross-country-tuned KYB shock. Destination charge listed at $675; MSRP was not shown on the Yamaha page checked.

models.title: 2027 YZ250F – significant changes
models.text: Yamaha's announcement leads with major changes to the YZ250F. $9,099 MSRP, available September. (Details of the changes are in the linked release.)

source.name: Racer X – Yamaha announces 2027 YZ lineup

models.title: Race team news — Yamaha riders at the Nations
models.text: At MXoN Ernée, Glenn Coldenhoff (GCR Yamaha) was 4th in MX2 and helped the Netherlands to 3rd; factory Yamaha's Karlis and Janis Reisulis helped Latvia to its best-ever 4th; Jed Beaton (CDR Yamaha) was 6th in MXGP.

events.title: Concluded — Yamaha Racing Ironman GNCC, the pink race (AMA National Championship, Rd 12)
events.text: Penultimate round of the 2026 Progressive GNCC series (off-road cross-country, not MX/SX), with Yamaha donating $50 per Yamaha class win and per national title earned by Yamaha riders to the Montgomery County Community Foundation's free mammogram program. Result: Phoenix Racing Yamaha's Brycen Neal won Saturday's pro ATV race and clinched his fifth XC1 Pro ATV national title, and Yamaha took the top six overall. GNCC's pro bike race report hadn't been published when checked Oct 26. The series finale is the Buckwheat 100 in Newburg, WV.

source.name: GNCC Racing – Yamaha Racing Ironman ATV race report (Oct 25, 2026)

events.title: Concluded — Yamaha Learn to Ride: Dirt Discovery
events.place: Loretta Lynn's Ranch, Hurricane Mills, TN
events.text: Two-hour learn-to-ride classes on 2027 TT-R bikes: kids 6–11 (Thu Oct 8, 9–11am), adults 12+ (Thu Oct 8, 1–3pm), women (Fri Oct 9, 9–11am). Seats are first-come and confirmed by Yamaha BLU CRU. Event window was Oct 8–11, 2026 (now concluded).

events.title: Concluded — The Fall Ride 2026 (Yamaha demo rides)
events.place: Loretta Lynn's Ranch, Hurricane Mills, TN
events.text: Halloween-themed dirt bike/ATV trail ride: 20+ miles of trails, campfires, vendors, live music and demo rides of the latest Yamaha dirt bikes and SXS. Event window was Oct 8–11, 2026 (now concluded).

deals.title: Customer cash on select YZ / WR models (new Oct 1)
deals.text: Yamaha USA 'Limited Time Offers': $1,500 on 2024 YZ450F; $1,000 on 2025–26 YZ450F, 2024 YZ250F and 2024 YZ450FX; $750 on 2025 YZ250F, 2026 YZ450FX and 2024 YZ125, YZ250, YZ125X, YZ250X and YZ250FX; $500 on 2025–26 YZ125 and YZ250, 2026 YZ250F, 2025–26 YZ250FX, YZ125X and YZ250X, 2025 YZ450FX and 2024–26 WR450F. Valid Oct 1 – Dec 31, 2026; no 2027 models listed. See a Yamaha dealer for full details.

ownerApp.title: YZ250F Owner App
ownerApp.text: Kyle's 2022 YZ250F workshop: maintenance jobs, torque specs, Power Tuner map cards with .yptsjsnz downloads, lubes & care, track-day service kit part numbers, schedule and bike specs. Installable as a phone app (PWA) and works offline after first load.

list.name: Kawasaki

models.title: Race team news — Chase Sexton and Kawasaki part ways
models.text: Kawasaki and Chase Sexton mutually agreed on Oct 23, 2026 to part ways effective immediately, one season into a reported three-year deal. Kawasaki credited him with two 2026 450SX wins (Anaheim, Salt Lake City). His 2027 team hasn't been announced. Racer X reports Garrett Marchbanks has been extended and Malcolm Stewart is expected on the team (neither officially announced yet), and that Kawasaki kept Stewart out of the Paris SX (Nov 21–22).

source.name: Racer X – Kawasaki and Chase Sexton part ways (Oct 23, 2026)

models.title: Race team news — Nate Thrasher joins Monster Energy/Pro Circuit Kawasaki
models.text: Pro Circuit Kawasaki's 2027 250 roster (announced Oct 19): Levi Kitchen (reigning 250SMX champ), Seth Hammaker, Drew Adams, Nick Romano (now full-time) and newcomer Nate Thrasher, a seven-time 250SX winner coming from Star Yamaha, on the KX250F.

source.name: Racer X – Pro Circuit Kawasaki 2027 roster: Thrasher joins (Oct 19, 2026)

models.title: 2027 KX450F – new frame and swingarm
models.text: The "F" returns to the name. New frame and swingarm with a longer wheelbase, revised suspension, intake/exhaust updates, full Brembo brakes and improved smartphone tuning. $10,299 MSRP, available late 2026. KX450FX: $10,599. Racer X (Oct 23) says the 2027 KX450 reaches dealers at the beginning of November, with the media intro on Nov 23. In Japan, Kawasaki Motors Japan put the KX450F/KX450FX on sale Oct 24.

models.title: 2027 KX250F – more power, sharper focus
models.text: Combustion chamber, exhaust length and silencer refinements, updated FI settings, larger-capacity clutch and revised suspension settings. $8,599 MSRP, available summer 2026. KX250FX: $8,699.

models.title: New KX327 and KX327X two-strokes
models.text: Kawasaki introduced an all-new fuel-injected 327cc two-stroke single in a chassis derived from the KX450F — first new Kawasaki 2-stroke over 250cc in more than two decades. US MSRP: KX327 $9,099; KX327X $9,699. Availability: late 2026.

source.name: Kawasaki Motors USA – KX327/KX327X press release

models.title: Race team news — Febvre wins MXoN Race 1 in his final KRT ride
models.text: Romain Febvre won Race 1 at Ernée and was 2nd in the MXGP class (1-3) in his last race for Kawasaki Racing Team. Pauls Jonass (Kawasaki) was 3rd in Open (3-8) and Levi Kitchen (Pro Circuit Kawasaki) 7th in MX2.

deals.title: Factory savings on 2026 KX models (through Dec 31)
deals.text: Kawasaki USA 'Current Offers' lists savings on select new unregistered models: $2,500 on the 2026 KX450, 2026 KX450X and 2025 KX450SR; $1,750 on the 2026 KX250 and KX250X; $500 on the 2026 KX65, KX85/85 L and KX112. Headline tiles say 'up to $3,000' (KX450F/FX) and 'up to $2,500' (KX250F/FX). Cash savings can't be combined with promotional financing; valid through 12/31/2026 at participating dealers. No 2027 KX models are listed.

No Kawasaki-brand dirt-bike apparel sale found.

list.name: Suzuki

models.title: Race team news — Barcia to debut Twisted Tea Suzuki at AUSX Open Geelong
models.text: AUSX confirmed Oct 16 that Justin Barcia races the Nov 7 AUSX Open at GMHBA Stadium on his new Twisted Tea Suzuki presented by Progressive Insurance alongside teammate Ken Roczen — an early Suzuki debut before A1. SX1 also lists Jo Shimoda, Christian Craig, Cedric Soubeyras and Luke Clout.

source.name: AUSX – Barcia locked in for Geelong (Oct 16, 2026)

models.title: Race team news — Justin Barcia signs with Suzuki / Pipes Motorsports
models.text: Barcia will race the RM-Z450 for Pipes Motorsports Group (2026 Supercross title-winning team) in 2027, with a mutual option for 2028. Debut: Jan 9, 2027 at Anaheim.

source.name: Racer X – Barcia joins Suzuki & Pipes Motorsports (Oct 3, 2026)

models.title: 2027 RM-Z450 – new KYB suspension
models.text: Replaces the Showa fork/BFRC shock with KYB suspension, plus lighter RK Excel wheels, slimmer subframe, revised exhaust internals and a new AMA/FIM-compliant silencer. $9,699 MSRP.

source.name: Powersports Business – Suzuki unveils first wave of 2027 models

models.title: 2027 RM-Z250 – updated settings, new rims and tires
models.text: Updated KYB suspension settings, RK Excel rims, Dunlop Geomax MX34 tires and a revised exhaust. $8,499 MSRP.

models.title: RM Army package: Roczen Championship Replica graphics
models.text: Eligible new 2027 RM-Z250/RM-Z450 buyers get a Ken Roczen Championship Replica Graphics Kit and a Pro Circuit T-6 exhaust, celebrating Roczen's 2026 AMA Supercross title.

source.name: Dirt Bike Magazine – 2027 Suzuki motocross models

deals.title: Autumn customer cash: $1,000 on 2024–2026 RM-Z250
deals.text: Suzuki’s Autumn Deal$ program (Oct 1 – Dec 31, 2026) lists $1,000 customer cash on new unregistered 2024, 2025 and 2026 RM-Z250 models (and higher tiers on select DR-Z models). Cash excludes promotional financing; see suzukicycles.com/offers for qualifying models.

deals.title: RM-Z Champion Edition package (free exhaust + Roczen graphics)
deals.text: Buy a new 2027 RM-Z250 or RM-Z450 and receive a Pro Circuit RM Army Edition T-6 full system (ARV $1,349.99) plus a custom Ken Roczen replica graphics kit. Kit ships to the dealer after retail registration; installation not included. Offer ends Dec 31, 2026 per the official RM-Z250 page.

notFound: No US Suzuki dirt-bike event found as of Oct 5, 2026.
No Suzuki-brand dirt-bike apparel sale found (Champion Edition graphics/exhaust are tied to a new 2027 RM-Z purchase).

list.name: Honda

models.title: Race team news — Michael Mosiman joins Quad Lock Honda
models.text: Quad Lock Honda signed Michael Mosiman (ex-Star Yamaha) on Oct 22 for its 2027 250 program across Supercross, Pro Motocross and SMX, alongside Cameron McAdoo. The team says American Honda has stepped up support and Kevin Windham will help with rider development and testing.

source.name: Racer X – Michael Mosiman to Quad Lock Honda (Oct 22, 2026)

models.title: Race team news — Joey Savatgy leaves Quad Lock Honda
models.text: Quad Lock Honda and Joey Savatgy parted ways Oct 16 after three seasons; the team said WSX's cancellation means it can't proceed with his 2027 contract and it will focus on its U.S. program. Savatgy is linked to TLD Red Bull Ducati (not official).

source.name: Racer X – Quad Lock Honda thanks Joey Savatgy (Oct 16, 2026)

models.title: Race team news — Herlings wins FastCross in Italy
models.text: One week after sweeping the MXoN Open class, Jeffrey Herlings (Honda) won the FastCross invitational in Arsago Seprio with a 5-1-1 scorecard (Oct 11). Tom Vialle (Honda) won Race 1.

models.title: Race team news — Herlings sweeps the MXoN Open class
models.text: Jeffrey Herlings (Honda HRC Petronas) won both of his races (1-1) to take the Open class and lift the Netherlands to 3rd. Alex Larwood (Honda) was 8th in MX2 for Australia.

models.title: Race team news — Cameron McAdoo joins Quad Lock Honda
models.text: Three-time 250SX main event winner McAdoo joins Quad Lock Honda for 2027 AMA Supercross as the team, with more American Honda support, targets the 250SX title.

source.name: Racer X – McAdoo joins Quad Lock Honda (Oct 2, 2026)

models.title: 2027 CRF450R – all-new engine, frame and suspension
models.text: Honda calls it a ground-up update: new 450cc Unicam engine, new frame with slightly more rake and a longer wheelbase, footpegs moved back 5 mm, new suspension and new look, plus a limited CRF450R HRC Works Edition. US MSRP $10,099 plus $600 destination.

models.title: 2027 CRF250R – new graphics, HRC Works Edition rename
models.text: The CRF250R and CRF250RX get the new HRC family graphics after their major 2025 overhaul; the CRF250RWE is renamed CRF250R HRC-WE.

models.title: Price source for the 2027 CRF450R
models.text: The $10,099 MSRP and $600 destination figure comes from the spec listing below, not a Honda page we could read directly.

deals.text: $1,500 Bonus Bucks (accessories, HondaCare or down payment) on new, unregistered 2026 and 2025 CRF450R models was listed through Nov 30, 2026. The accompanying 3.99% APR financing ended Sep 30, 2026.
